unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: Required carriers remain uncued exact-answer tests
evidence: P1L3 accepts only Admittedly / that said; Granted / even so fits the same concession and continuation and has already been taught.
P1L8 accepts only By growth I mean before marketable skills; What I mean is, modeled in this very lesson, also produces a coherent explanation.
P2L1 accepts only What I mean is before line three; I mean is equally grammatical and coherent.
P2L6 accepts provided that / providing that but rejects if in mail counts ... it’s postmarked by Friday.
P2L10 accepts only for the record where in summary also introduces the requested summary.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.whyArbitrationDoesNotCloseIt: The author-facing requirement B2-EN-17 and a previously modeled sentence do not tell the learner that the current open blank is exact reproduction. No implemented B2 instruction or explicit retrieval cue has been demonstrated. A German meaning cue alone would not distinguish these synonyms.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.proposedCorrection: At minimum accept the known valid alternatives in the authored lists, then check other open frames for the same failure. Where one exact carrier must be retrieved, provide and verify a visible instruction or existing-schema choice that actually constrains that carrier; respect the one-choice-blank limit. Do not assume future runtime alias expansion. P2L4's newly accepted In short closes that specific subcase only.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: Detail distractors need the intended meaning on the B2 screen
unresolvedPublicationFindings.evidence: Alternatives such as a large team in P1L8, three hundred in P2L4, or fourteen weeks in P2L6 are grammatical invented details unless the learner has a visible required meaning. Their offscreen German source field is not itself a screen cue. The original P2L7 January example is repaired and is no longer part of this hold.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.proposedCorrection: Before publication, implement or demonstrate the B2 adapter rendering the correct dialogue[1].base.de beside the build task and verify it with these exact sources. Review the detail distractors against that rendered context. Alternatively replace individual distractors with options already contradicted by the visible English frame. Existing A1/A2/B1 cue rendering is useful precedent, not acceptance evidence for B2.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: Split the difference still glossed as sharing an extra fare
unresolvedPublicationFindings.evidence: Both revised bases say teilen wir uns die Differenz zum Busticket. That describes sharing an additional cost between people. The spoken idiom proposes meeting halfway or compromising between positions. Merely identifying a fare gap does not establish an agreement to divide that cost.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.proposedCorrection: Keep the English recording text and render the proposal as a price compromise in both German bases. For example: Ich bin nicht bereit, zwanzig Stunden zu verlieren; sofern der Dienstagstarif noch verfügbar ist, finden wir einen preislichen Mittelweg; andernfalls verkürzen wir die Küstenreise. Do not teach the phrase as an idiom for sharing extra costs.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.localTtsSeparation: This narrower disposition supersedes the initial precautionary hold on the English line: the idiom is valid as a compromise proposal even though its German gloss is wrong. No fare amount, exact halfway price, or cost-sharing contract is asserted by this recording clearance.
